docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $750.00 FILED BY ARAVENA,EMMANUEL AS TO DEFENDANT COMISKY ROCHE FUNERAL HOME HERNANDEZ,RICARDO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-13-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT HERNANDEZ,RICARDO
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION APR-13-1994, CONTINUED BY COURT TO APR-26-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ARAVENA,EMMANUEL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT COMISKY ROCHE FUNERAL HOME HERNANDEZ,RICARDO PLFT STATED IN OPEN COURT THAT HE WANTS ONLY THE ASHES OF MRS P.
